subject: What the tech sell-off means for your portfolio
draft: Samantha, on the tech sell-off: Nvidia is down 30% in two weeks and US stocks about 8%. Your invested savings are 85.1% in stocks, technology is 30.6% of your stock holdings and 92.6% is in the US, so you'll feel this more than most. Two steadying facts: your $80,000 in cash covers 7.9 months of essentials, and Ethan's $12,500 college payment isn't due until August 2027, so nothing forces a decision today. Your plan already flagged the tech and US concentration and the tax cost of your taxable holdings, about $3,032 a year. This is a good moment to look at both together, starting with the missing cost basis so we know what any change would really cost.
voice_script: Hi Samantha, it's Mohamed. With tech down this much, your portfolio will show it, since technology is 30.6% of your stock holdings. Your $80,000 cash cushion means nothing is forced today. Let's use this moment to look at the concentration your plan already flagged.
